<documents>
<document id="docs-account-details">
FindingˆyourˆaccountˆandˆroutingˆnumbersˆYourˆroutingˆnumberˆandˆaccountˆnumberˆareˆinˆtheˆappˆunderˆAccountˆdetails.ˆYou'llˆneedˆthemˆforˆdirectˆdeposit,ˆtoˆlinkˆTallowbrookˆatˆanotherˆbank,ˆorˆtoˆreceiveˆaˆwire.ˆ##ˆWhereˆtoˆfindˆthemˆTapˆProfile,ˆthenˆAccountˆdetails.ˆTapˆtheˆeyeˆiconˆtoˆshowˆtheˆfullˆaccountˆnumber.ˆTheˆappˆasksˆyouˆtoˆconfirmˆit'sˆyouˆfirst.ˆ##ˆCardˆnumberˆversusˆaccountˆnumberˆYourˆcardˆnumberˆisˆdifferentˆfromˆyourˆaccountˆnumber.ˆDon'tˆgiveˆyourˆcardˆnumberˆtoˆanˆemployerˆforˆdirectˆdeposit.ˆ##ˆKeepingˆthemˆsafeˆOnlyˆgiveˆyourˆaccountˆandˆroutingˆnumbersˆtoˆpeopleˆandˆcompaniesˆyouˆtrust,ˆsuchˆasˆyourˆemployer.ˆSomeoneˆwithˆtheseˆnumbersˆcanˆtryˆtoˆpullˆmoneyˆbyˆACH.ˆIfˆthatˆhappens,ˆyouˆcanˆdisputeˆit.ˆ##ˆSupportˆwon'tˆreadˆthemˆoutˆForˆsecurity,ˆsupportˆwon'tˆreadˆyourˆfullˆaccountˆnumberˆorˆcardˆnumberˆtoˆyouˆinˆchatˆorˆonˆtheˆphone.ˆYouˆcanˆalwaysˆseeˆthemˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆ##ˆWireˆinstructionsˆForˆincomingˆwires,ˆuseˆtheˆWireˆinstructionsˆscreenˆunderˆAccountˆdetails,ˆwhichˆalsoˆshowsˆourˆSWIFTˆcodeˆforˆinternationalˆwires.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="support-no-advice">
FinancialˆadviceˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆcanˆexplainˆhowˆTallowbrookˆproductsˆwork,ˆbutˆweˆcan'tˆgiveˆfinancial,ˆinvestment,ˆtaxˆorˆlegalˆadvice.ˆ##ˆWhatˆweˆcan'tˆhelpˆwithˆ-ˆWhetherˆtoˆinvest,ˆsaveˆorˆpayˆdownˆdebtˆ-ˆWhichˆstocks,ˆfundsˆorˆcryptocurrenciesˆtoˆbuyˆorˆsellˆ-ˆHowˆmuchˆofˆyourˆmoneyˆtoˆkeepˆinˆsavingsˆ-ˆHowˆtoˆreportˆinterestˆorˆotherˆincomeˆonˆyourˆtaxesˆ-ˆLegalˆquestionsˆaboutˆwills,ˆdivorceˆorˆdisputesˆwithˆotherˆpeopleˆ##ˆWhatˆweˆcanˆhelpˆwithˆ-ˆHowˆourˆsavingsˆratesˆandˆSavingsˆPocketsˆworkˆ-ˆFeesˆandˆlimitsˆonˆeachˆplan,ˆsoˆyouˆcanˆdecideˆwhichˆsuitsˆyouˆ-ˆYourˆstatementsˆandˆtaxˆformsˆ##ˆWhereˆtoˆgetˆadviceˆForˆadviceˆaboutˆyourˆsituation,ˆtalkˆtoˆaˆqualifiedˆfinancialˆadviser,ˆtaxˆprofessionalˆorˆlawyer.ˆ##ˆInvestingˆTallowbrookˆdoesn'tˆofferˆinvestmentˆorˆbrokerageˆaccounts.ˆSeeˆ"Investingˆandˆcryptocurrency".ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
<document id="support-contact">
ContactingˆsupportˆHere'sˆhowˆtoˆreachˆus.ˆ##ˆChatˆinˆtheˆappˆTapˆHelp,ˆthenˆMessageˆus.ˆChatˆisˆopenˆaroundˆtheˆclock,ˆeveryˆday.ˆIt'sˆtheˆfastestˆwayˆtoˆreachˆus,ˆandˆweˆalreadyˆknowˆit'sˆyouˆbecauseˆyou'reˆsignedˆin.ˆ##ˆPhoneˆCallˆ+1ˆ555ˆ0142ˆfromˆ8:00ˆAMˆETˆtoˆ8:00ˆPMˆET,ˆeveryˆday.ˆYou'llˆbeˆaskedˆtoˆconfirmˆaˆcodeˆinˆtheˆappˆtoˆproveˆit'sˆyou.ˆ##ˆEmailˆEmailˆsupport@tallowbrook.exampleˆifˆyouˆcan'tˆsignˆin.ˆWeˆreplyˆbyˆemail,ˆbutˆforˆyourˆsecurityˆweˆcan'tˆmakeˆchangesˆtoˆyourˆaccountˆbyˆemail.ˆ##ˆSpecialistˆteamsˆSomeˆrequestsˆgoˆtoˆaˆspecialistˆteam,ˆsuchˆasˆFraud,ˆDisputesˆorˆVerification.ˆTheyˆreplyˆwithinˆ2ˆbusinessˆdays.ˆ##ˆBewareˆofˆfakesˆOnlyˆuseˆtheˆcontactˆdetailsˆinˆtheˆappˆorˆonˆthisˆhelpˆcenter.ˆScammersˆpostˆfakeˆsupportˆnumbersˆonline.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
</documents>
